systems.country_label: processus de digitalisation de l'état civil
systems.tiers: at pilot phase in December 2024, to extend to 40 localities in 2025, by the country's delegate at the Abidjan symposium of 10-12 December 2024

note: A news report of the Abidjan civil registration symposium of 10-12 December 2024: the country's delegate describes an EU-backed digitisation of civil registration still at its pilot, due in 40 localities in 2025; an application, with nothing stated on the connection of any commune office. The term 'communes' falls in the Burkina Faso section.
